title: gymnogramma palmata
intro: Gymnogramma palmata, commonly known as the Palmate Gymnogramma, is a type of fern that belongs to the family Polypodiaceae. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, which include its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties.
